name: Meta Ads
focus: Creative that meets the right audience.
description: Connect the offer, the audience and the creative across Facebook and Instagram. We plan the journey from first impression to a useful next step.
plan: Clarify the offer and conversion goal.
Build audience and creative test groups.
Review delivery, conversion quality and the next test.
measure: Qualified leads, purchases, cost per result and attributed revenue where available.

name: Google Ads
scope: Search, Shopping, Display, YouTube & Performance Max
description: Build around buying intent, a relevant offer and a clear landing page. Pair automated delivery with search-term reviews and conversion-quality checks.
plan: Prioritize high-intent searches and match the landing-page promise.
Give automation clear conversion goals, relevant assets and budget boundaries.
Review search terms, qualified leads and revenue alongside clicks and cost.
measure: Conversion value, cost per acquisition, ROAS and lead quality as appropriate to the goal.

name: TikTok Ads
focus: A clear hook. A reason to keep watching.
description: Build TikTok campaign plans around the opening hook, the message and the action. Creative testing explores different ways to explain the offer.
plan: Define the audience and the message.
Plan distinct hooks and creative variations.
Review creative response alongside actual conversion quality.
measure: Creative engagement, conversion rate, cost per action and downstream business outcomes.

name: LinkedIn Ads
focus: Reach the buying team, not just a job title.
description: Connect a relevant B2B offer with the professionals it is designed to help. Align campaign targeting, the content offer and the lead handover.
plan: Agree the ideal customer and buying roles.
Align the offer with audience needs.
Review qualified leads with the sales team.
measure: Cost per lead, lead fit, qualified opportunities and pipeline outcomes when CRM data is available.

name: Pinterest Ads
description: Connect visual discovery with relevant products and useful destination pages. Plan shopping and discovery campaigns around the way the audience explores ideas.
plan: Map the product to audience interests.
Prepare relevant visuals and destination pages.
Review product discovery and conversion signals.
measure: Product engagement, outbound visits, conversions and attributed sales where available.

name: Microsoft Ads
focus: A focused plan for another search audience.
description: Develop Bing Search and Shopping campaign plans with clear intent, product relevance and conversion goals. Review the channel on its own evidence.
plan: Set the channel objective and conversion goal.
Organize keywords, product data and destination pages.
Review search terms, conversion quality and spend.
measure: Cost per acquisition, conversion value, search-term relevance and qualified outcomes.
